text: いれかえる　わざを　えらんで　ください

structure.jp: いれかえる　わざを
えらんで　ください

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.span: えらんで　ください
patterns.explanation: ください after the て-form of a verb politely asks someone to do it. えらんで ください = 'please choose'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing is meant. いれかえる わざ = 'the move to swap out'.
